Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Stack: C++/MinGW, Go, TypeScript/React. Build: `npm run build` (or individual `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`). Test: `npm run test`.

Privacy/local-first: data stays local; app works offline; external calls only when necessary (Gmail API); avoid paid services. Use TypeScript strict mode. Keep related code colocated, minimize splitting/bloat. Use React Bootstrap/Radix UI; No Tailwind. Prepare translations with message catalogs/i18n; technical documentation remains in English.

Interceptor `src/interceptor/`: Simple MAPI only, zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json - hand-rolled JSON), non-blocking, thread-safe; writes JSON to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Always test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Test multiple apps (Explorer, PDF viewers, etc.); check memory leaks/thread safety. Files: `main.cpp`, `mapi_impl.cpp`, `json_writer.cpp`, `fs_utils.cpp`.

Native host `src/native-host/`: Chrome Native Messaging, filesystem watching, protocol length-prefixed JSON. Files: `main.go`, `protocol.go`, `watcher.go`; `gofmt` before committing. Test native messaging; handle deleted files/permission errors.

Extension `src/extension/`: React 18, React Bootstrap, Vite, TypeScript; Chrome Identity API OAuth. Use `manifest.json`, `src/background/service-worker.ts`, `src/popup/App.tsx`, `src/types/messages.ts`. Keep service worker minimal; test Chrome and Edge.

Schema: [docs/json-schema.json](docs/json-schema.json). Comment the "why", not the "what"; document non-obvious constraints; keep comments concise. Use Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`.

Workflow: understand component; read source; run tests; identify related files; follow patterns; keep changes minimal; add tests; update docs. Run full build: `npm run build`; run tests: `npm run test`; test manually for user-facing changes; write clear commits.

Schema changes: update `docs/json-schema.json`, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TypeScript types in `src/extension/src/types/`, Go structs in `src/native-host/`. Settings: Chrome storage API, settings UI, service worker, `chrome.storage.sync`. Release: `npm run build`; `npm run register:mapi`; load extension in Chrome/Edge developer mode; inspect `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`; inspect extension DevTools.
